title: exclude option fails on paths with capital letters
body:

- [x] I am on the [latest](https://github.com/sdispater/poetry/releases/latest) Poetry version.
- [x] I have searched the [issues](https://github.com/sdispater/poetry/issues) of this repo and believe that this is not a duplicate.

<!--

  it'd be very helpful to whoever handles the issue.
-->

- **OS version and name**: Win10 64-bit, Py3.7
- **Poetry version**: 0.12.10
- **Link of a [Gist](https://gist.github.com/) with the contents of your pyproject.toml file**: https://gist.github.com/TOffergeld/89d5fa517edbd51ccc8eac518f5e2035
## Issue
There seems to be an issue with the exclude section in the pyproject.toml files with paths containing capital letters.
The issue can be reproduced with the example .toml file and a directory setup as follows:

```
poetry_example
-- __init__.py
-- Foo
------ Bar.py
------ lowercasebar.py
-- bar
------ foo.py
------ Capitalfoo.py
```

`poetry build -vv` yields:
```
Building poetry_example (0.1.0)
 - Building sdist
 - Adding: poetry_example\__init__.py.py
 - Adding: poetry_example\bar\Capitalfoo.py
 - Adding: poetry_example\Foo\Bar.py
 - Adding: poetry_example\Foo\lowercasebar.py
 - Adding: pyproject.toml
 - Built poetry_example-0.1.0.tar.gz

 - Building wheel
 - Adding: [...]\poetry_example-0.1.0\poetry_example\__init__.py.py
 - Adding: [...]\poetry_example-0.1.0\poetry_example\bar\Capitalfoo.py
 - Adding: [...]\poetry_example-0.1.0\poetry_example\Foo\Bar.py
 - Adding: [...]\poetry_example-0.1.0\poetry_example\Foo\lowercasebar.py
 - Built poetry_example-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl
```
in which only one (bar/foo.py) of the four files specified to be excluded actually gets excluded.

The same issues also seems to affect exclusions through the vcs.
